```{r}
hg <- function(df){
   df |> head() |> glimpse()
}

ai <- function(df){
  df |> select(-any_of(c("cid", "pid", "hid", "lfd"))) |> hg()
}
```

```{r}
      AGET1 == 2 ~ "Age_T1[18.0-40.0]",
      AGET3 == 2 ~ "Age_T3[60.0-97.0]",
      TRUE       ~ "Age_T2[40.0-60.0]"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("Age_T1[18.0-40.0]", "Age_T2[40.0-60.0]", "Age_T3[60.0-97.0]")),

    Mig = case_when(
      MIGY == 2 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE      ~ "No"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("No", "Yes")),

    Gender = case_when(
      GENF == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE      ~ "Not female"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("Not female", "Female")),

    Education = case_when(
      EDTERT == 2 ~ "Tertiary (ISCED 5-8)",
      EDNA   == 2 ~ "missing",
      TRUE        ~ "Non-tertiary (ISCED 0-4)"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("Non-tertiary (ISCED 0-4)", "Tertiary (ISCED 5-8)", "missing")),

    Employment = case_when(
      EMPP   == 2 ~ "Part-time or flexible",
      EMPNO  == 2 ~ "Not currently employed, training",
      EMPRET == 2 ~ "Retirement",
      EMPNA  == 2 ~ "missing",
      TRUE        ~ "Full-time"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("Full-time", "Part-time or flexible",
                            "Not currently employed, training", "Retirement", "missing")),

    ChildHH = case_when(
      KIDY  == 2 ~ "Child in hh",
      KIDNA == 2 ~ "missing",
      TRUE       ~ "No child"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("No child", "Child in hh", "missing")),

    EquivIncome = case_when(
      INCT1 == 2 ~ "EquivIncome_T1min",
      INCT3 == 2 ~ "EquivIncome_T3max",
      INCNA == 2 ~ "missing",
      TRUE       ~ "EquivIncome_T2med"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("EquivIncome_T1min", "EquivIncome_T2med",
                             "EquivIncome_T3max", "missing")),

    TargetGroup = case_when(
      TGANC == 2 ~ "Anchor",
      TRUE       ~ "HH member"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("HH member", "Anchor"))
  )

df |> ai()
```

### Prediction: Which Model to Choose

```{r}

# Given a model, predict values of yvar from xvar
# This function supports one predictor and one predicted variable
# xrange: If NULL, determine the x range from the model object. If a vector with
#   two numbers, use those as the min and max of the prediction range.
# samples: Number of samples across the x range.
# ...: Further arguments to be passed to predict()
predictvals <- function(model, xvar, yvar, xrange = NULL, samples = 100, ...) {

  # If xrange isn't passed in, determine xrange from the models.
  # Different ways of extracting the x range, depending on model type
  if (is.null(xrange)) {
    if (any(class(model) %in% c("lm", "glm")))
      xrange <- range(model$model[[xvar]])
    else if (any(class(model) %in% "loess"))
      xrange <- range(model$x)
  }

  newdata <- data.frame(x = seq(xrange[1], xrange[2], length.out = samples))
  names(newdata) <- xvar
  newdata[[yvar]] <- predict(model, newdata = newdata, ...)
  newdata
}

geom_lm <- function(formula = y ~ x, colour = alpha("steelblue", 0.5), 
                    linewidth = 2, ...)  {
  geom_smooth(formula = formula, se = FALSE, method = "lm", colour = colour,
    linewidth = linewidth, ...)
}

mod_loes <- loess(cprob_opt_w2 ~ cprob_opt_wave1, df)
loess_predicted <- predictvals(mod_loes, "cprob_opt_wave1", "cprob_opt_w2")

#zshg_opti <- 
  ggplot(df, aes(cprob_opt_w2, cprob_opt_wave1)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_lm() +
  geom_lm(y ~ poly(x, 2), linewidth = 1, colour = "red") + 
  geom_lm(y ~ poly(x, 10), linewidth = 1, colour = "green") +
  geom_line(data = loess_predicted, color = "pink", linewidth = .8)

# ggsave(file = "path/to/plots/zshg_opti.png", zshg_opti, 
#        width = 6,
#        height = 4,
#        dpi = 300)
```

# Predicting Satisficing

```{r}
p_load(modelsummary, rcompanion)


# ── 1. Dummy coding and factor levels ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    y_opt_w2    = as.integer(LC_w2 == "Softsat"),
    y_exm_w2    = as.integer(LC_w2 == "Extremist"),
    y_indiff_w2 = as.integer(LC_w2 == "Indifferent"),
    y_opt_wave3      = as.integer(LC_wave3   == "Softsat"),
    y_exm_wave3      = as.integer(LC_wave3   == "Extremist"),
    y_indiff_wave3   = as.integer(LC_wave3   == "Indifferent"),
    Mode_wave1     = factor(Mode_wave1, levels = c("Paper", "Web")),
    Mode_w2     = factor(Mode_w2, levels = c("Paper", "Web")),
    Mode_wave3       = factor(Mode_wave3,   levels = c("Paper", "Web"))
  )

# ── 2. Consistent analysis subsets ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_wave1_w2 <- df |> filter(!is.na(cprob_opt_wave1) & !is.na(LC_w2))
df_w2_wave3   <- df |> filter(!is.na(cprob_opt_w2) & !is.na(LC_wave3))
df_wave1_wave3   <- df |> filter(!is.na(cprob_opt_wave1) & !is.na(LC_wave3))

# ── 3. Model estimation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


# Softsat
#wave 2 by wave 1
w2_opt <- glm(y_opt_w2 ~ cprob_opt_wave1    * Mode_wave1, data = df_wave1_w2, family = binomial)
#wave 3 by wave 2
wave3_opt_2 <- glm(y_opt_wave3   ~ cprob_opt_w2    * Mode_w2, data = df_w2_wave3,   family = binomial)
#wave 3 by wave 1
wave3_opt_1 <- glm(y_opt_wave3   ~ cprob_opt_wave1    * Mode_wave1, data = df_wave1_wave3,   family = binomial)

# Extremist
w2_exm <- glm(y_exm_w2 ~ cprob_exm_wave1   * Mode_wave1, data = df_wave1_w2, family = binomial)
wave3_exm_2 <- glm(y_exm_wave3   ~ cprob_exm_w2   * Mode_w2, data = df_w2_wave3,   family = binomial)
wave3_exm_1 <- glm(y_exm_wave3   ~ cprob_exm_wave1   * Mode_wave1, data = df_wave1_wave3,   family = binomial)

# Indifferent
w2_ind <- glm(y_indiff_w2 ~ cprob_indiff_wave1 * Mode_wave1, data = df_wave1_w2, family = binomial)
wave3_ind_2 <- glm(y_indiff_wave3   ~ cprob_indiff_w2 * Mode_w2, data = df_w2_wave3,   family = binomial)
wave3_ind_1 <- glm(y_indiff_wave3   ~ cprob_indiff_wave1 * Mode_wave1, data = df_wave1_wave3,   family = binomial)

# ── 4. Regression tables ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fmt <- function(x) format(round(x, 3), big.mark = ",")
gm  <- list(list("raw" = "nobs", "clean" = "N", "fmt" = fmt))

modelsummary(
  list("W2 by Wave 1" = w2_opt, "Wave 3 by W2" = wave3_opt_2, "Wave 3 by Wave 1" = wave3_opt_1),
  title        = "Softsat",
  exponentiate = TRUE, vcov = "HC1", cluster = ~ hid,
  stars        = c("*" = .05, "**" = .01, "***" = .001),
  statistic    = "conf.int", gof_map = gm, output = "flextable"
)



modelsummary(
  list("W2 by Wave 1" = w2_exm, "Wave 3 by W2" = wave3_exm_2, "Wave 3 by Wave 1" = wave3_exm_1),
  title        = "Extremist",
  exponentiate = TRUE, vcov = "HC1", cluster = ~ hid,
  stars        = c("*" = .05, "**" = .01, "***" = .001),
  statistic    = "conf.int", gof_map = gm, output = "flextable"
)



modelsummary(
  list("W2 by Wave 1" = w2_ind, "Wave 3 by W2" = wave3_ind_2, "Wave 3 by Wave 1" = wave3_ind_1),
  title        = "Indifferent",
  exponentiate = TRUE, vcov = "HC1", cluster = ~ hid,
  stars        = c("*" = .05, "**" = .01, "***" = .001),
  statistic    = "conf.int", gof_map = gm, output = "flextable"
)

models_named <- list(
  "Opt:  W2 by Wave 1" = w2_opt, "Opt:  Wave 3 by W2" = wave3_opt_2, "Opt:  Wave 3 by Wave 1" = wave3_opt_1,
  "ExM:  W2 by Wave 1" = w2_exm, "ExM:  Wave 3 by W2" = wave3_exm_2, "ExM:  Wave 3 by Wave 1" = wave3_exm_1,
  "Ind:  W2 by Wave 1" = w2_ind, "Ind:  Wave 3 by W2" = wave3_ind_2, "Ind:  Wave 3 by Wave 1" = wave3_ind_1
)

imap(models_named, ~ {
  cat("\n──", .y, "──\n")
  print(rcompanion::nagelkerke(.x)$Pseudo.R.squared.for.model.vs.null)
})


# ── Opt:  W2 by Wave 1 ──
```


```{r}
#| label: table-logreg-latex
# Purpose: build the LaTeX table of the logistic regressions directly from
# the fitted models; the table layout is described once and all numbers are
# taken from the model objects at render time.

# ── Helper functions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
nagR2 <- function(model) {
  round(rcompanion::nagelkerke(model)$Pseudo.R.squared.for.model.vs.null[
    "Nagelkerke (Cragg and Uhler)", "Pseudo.R.squared"], 2)
}

mf <- function(model) {
  round(rcompanion::nagelkerke(model)$Pseudo.R.squared.for.model.vs.null[
    "McFadden", "Pseudo.R.squared"], 2)
}

get_stars <- function(model, term_idx) {
  se <- sqrt(diag(sandwich::vcovCL(model, cluster = ~ hid)))[term_idx]
  z  <- abs(coef(model)[term_idx] / se)
  p  <- 2 * pnorm(z, lower.tail = FALSE)
  case_when(p < .001 ~ "***", p < .01 ~ "**", p < .05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "")
}

extract <- function(model) {
  map(seq_along(coef(model)), ~ list(
    or    = round(exp(coef(model)[.x]), 3),
    ci_lo = round(exp(confint.default(model)[.x, 1]), 3),
    ci_hi = round(exp(confint.default(model)[.x, 2]), 3),
    stars = get_stars(model, .x)
  ))
}

num <- function(x) paste0("\\num{", x, "}")

# ── Which models form the columns / blocks, and how they are labelled ─────────
tab_spec <- list(
  caption = paste("Logistic Regression Results of Most Probable Satisficing",
                  "Pattern by Previous Likelihood of Same Satisficing"),
  label   = "tab:PredictionRegression",
  colheads = c("Logistic Parameter$^a$",
               "Wave 2 by 1.1", "Wave 2 by 2", "Wave 3 by 1.1"),
  firstcol = "OR [95\\% CI]",
  blocks = list(
    list(pattern = "Softsat",
         models  = list(w2_opt, wave3_opt_2, wave3_opt_1),
         terms   = c("(Intercept)",
                     "$\\hat{p}_{Softsat}$",
                     "Web Mode (Ref: Paper)",
                     "$\\hat{p}_{Softsat} \\times$ Web Mode")),
    list(pattern = "Extremist",
         models  = list(w2_exm, wave3_exm_2, wave3_exm_1),
         terms   = c("(Intercept)",
                     "$\\hat{p}_{Extremist}$",
                     "Web Mode (Ref: Paper)",
                     "$\\hat{p}_{Extremist} \\times$ Web Mode")),
    list(pattern = "Indifferents",
         models  = list(w2_ind, wave3_ind_2, wave3_ind_1),
         terms   = c("(Intercept)",
                     "$\\hat{p}_{Indifferents}$",
                     "Web Mode (Ref: Paper)",
                     "$\\hat{p}_{Indifferents} \\times$ Web Mode"))
  ),
  note = paste("OR = Odds Ratio. CI = confidence interval",
               "[lower level, upper level]. $\\hat{p}$ = model estimated posterior",
               "class probability of previous wave. $\\hat{c}_{modal}$ = most likely class",
               "membership. Robust standard errors with individuals clustered in",
               "households (HC1).")
)

# ── Row builders ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
or_row <- function(ex, i) {
  paste0(" & ", paste(map_chr(ex, ~ paste0(num(.x[[i]]$or), .x[[i]]$stars)), collapse = " & "), " \\\\")
}

ci_row <- function(ex, i) {
  paste0(" & ", paste(map_chr(ex, ~ paste0("{}[", num(.x[[i]]$ci_lo), ", ",
                                           num(.x[[i]]$ci_hi), "]")), collapse = " & "), " \\\\")
}

fit_row <- function(models, fun) {
  paste0(" & ", paste(map_chr(models, ~ num(fun(.x))), collapse = " & "), " \\\\")
}

block_rows <- function(block) {
  ex <- map(block$models, extract)
  out <- c(paste0(" & \\multicolumn{3}{c}{$\\hat{c}_{modal} =$ ", block$pattern, "} \\\\"))
  for (i in seq_along(block$terms)) {
    out <- c(out,
             paste0(block$terms[i], or_row(ex, i)),
             ci_row(ex, i))
  }
  out <- c(out,
           paste0("N", fit_row(block$models, function(m) nrow(m$model))),
           paste0("McFadden $R^2$", fit_row(block$models, mf)),
           paste0("Nagelkerke $R^2$", fit_row(block$models, nagR2)))
  out
}

# ── Assemble the LaTeX table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
latex <- c(
  "\\begin{table}",
  "  \\begin{threeparttable}",
  paste0("  \\caption{", tab_spec$caption, "}"),
  paste0("  \\label{", tab_spec$label, "}"),
  "  \\begin{tabular}[t]{@{}lccc@{}}",
  "  \\toprule",
  paste0("  ", paste(tab_spec$colheads, collapse = " & "), " \\\\ \\cline{2-4}"),
  paste0("  & ", paste(rep(tab_spec$firstcol, 3), collapse = " & "), " \\\\ \\midrule"),
  unlist(map(tab_spec$blocks, block_rows)),
  "  \\end{tabular}",
  "  \\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]",
  paste0("    \\item \\footnotesize \\textit{Note.} ", tab_spec$note),
  "    \\textsuperscript{a} Parameters refer to the characteristics of previous waves.",
  "    \\textsuperscript{*}p$<0.05$, \\textsuperscript{**}p$<0.01$, \\textsuperscript{***}p$<0.001$.",
  "  \\end{tablenotes}",
  "  \\end{threeparttable}",
  "\\end{table}"
)

# write out for the manuscript, and show it in the rendered document
#writeLines(latex, "table1_satisficing.tex")
cat(latex, sep = "\n")
```


# Correlations Plots



```{r}
#| label: correlation-plots 

# ── Long-Format aus df ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
wave1_long <- df |>
  select(pid, hid, Mode = Mode_wave1,
         pSoftsat    = cprob_opt_wave1,
         pExtremist    = cprob_exm_wave1,
         pIndifferent = cprob_indiff_wave1) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pSoftsat, pExtremist, pIndifferent),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "epp") |>
  mutate(Wave = "Wave 1")

w2_long <- df |>
  filter(!is.na(cprob_opt_w2)) |>
  select(pid, hid, Mode = Mode_w2,
         pSoftsat    = cprob_opt_w2,
         pExtremist    = cprob_exm_w2,
         pIndifferent = cprob_indiff_w2) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pSoftsat, pExtremist, pIndifferent),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "epp") |>
  mutate(Wave = "Wave 2")

wave3_long <- df |>
  filter(!is.na(cprob_opt_wave3)) |>
  select(pid, hid, Mode = Mode_wave3,
         pSoftsat    = cprob_opt_wave3,
         pExtremist    = cprob_exm_wave3,
         pIndifferent = cprob_indiff_wave3) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pSoftsat, pExtremist, pIndifferent),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "epp") |>
  mutate(Wave = "Wave 3")
# ── Plot function ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_cor_plot <- function(long_a, long_b, wave_a_label, wave_b_label, filename) {
  
  plot_df <- long_a |>
    select(pid, PatternA = variable, eppA = epp, ModeA = Mode) |>
    left_join(
      long_b |> select(pid, PatternB = variable, eppB = epp, ModeB = Mode),
      by = "pid",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) |>
    filter(PatternA %in% c("pSoftsat", "pExtremist", "pIndifferent"),
           PatternB %in% c("pSoftsat", "pExtremist", "pIndifferent")) |>
    mutate(
      ModeA = ifelse(ModeA == "Web", paste(wave_a_label, "Web"), paste(wave_a_label, "Paper")),
      ModeB = ifelse(ModeB == "Web", paste(wave_b_label, "Web"), paste(wave_b_label, "Paper"))
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = eppA, y = eppB)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
    geom_smooth(formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, method = "lm", color = "#1C7984", linewidth = 2) +
    stat_cor(p.accuracy = 0.001, method = "spearman",
             label.x = 0.02, label.y = -0.25,
             cor.coef.name = "rho", color = "black", size = 5.4, r.accuracy = 0.01) +
    labs(x = paste0("Model-estimated posterior probabilities at ", wave_a_label),
         y = paste0("Model-estimated posterior probabilities at ", wave_b_label)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), expand = c(0.1, 0.1)) +
    facet_grid(
      factor(ModeB, levels = c(paste(wave_b_label, "Web"), paste(wave_b_label, "Paper"))) +
      factor(PatternB, levels = c("pIndifferent", "pExtremist", "pSoftsat")) ~
      ModeA +
      factor(PatternA, levels = c("pSoftsat", "pExtremist", "pIndifferent"))
    ) +
    papaja::theme_apa() +
    theme(
      axis.title   = element_text(size = 17),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 40, size = 14),
      strip.text   = element_text(size = 16)
    )
  
#  ggsave(filename, p,
#       width = 16, height = 13, dpi = 300)
  p
}

# ── Create the plots ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cors_w2_by_wave1 <- make_cor_plot(wave1_long, w2_long, "Wave 1", "Wave 2", "LC_Cors_w2_by_w1_RR.png")
cors_wave3_by_w2   <- make_cor_plot(w2_long, wave3_long,   "Wave 2", "Wave 3",   "LC_Cors_w3_by_w2_RR.png")
cors_wave3_by_wave1   <- make_cor_plot(wave1_long, wave3_long,   "Wave 1", "Wave 3",   "LC_Cors_w3_by_w1_RR.png")



```

```{r}
p_load(ggh4x)


n_labels <- bind_rows(
  df |> count(LC = LC_wave1, Mode = Mode_wave1) |> mutate(Wave = "Wave 1"),
  df |> count(LC = LC_w2, Mode = Mode_w2) |> mutate(Wave = "Wave 2"),
  df |> count(LC = LC_wave3,   Mode = Mode_wave3)   |> mutate(Wave = "Wave 3")
) |>
  filter(!is.na(LC), !is.na(Mode)) |>
  mutate(
    label = paste0("N = ", format(n, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)),
    LC   = fct_relevel(LC,   "Softsat", "Indifferent", "Extremist"),
    Mode = fct_relevel(Mode, "Paper", "Web")
  )


cbPalette <- c("#000000", "#4F6E6A", "#CC79A7","#433C0A", "#39B4FF",  "#F0E442","#D55E00","#61AD7B", "#7003A9" ) 


omegas_plot <-
  omegas_df |>
    mutate(Indicator = fct_relevel(Indicator,
                           "Extremes selection",
                           "Midpoint selection",
                           "Open question nonresponse",
                           "Closed question nonresponse",
                           "Weak nondiff (often)",
                           "Strong nondiff (sometimes)",
                           "Strong nondiff (often)",
                           "Break-off",
                           "Speeding"),
           LC   = fct_relevel(LC,   "Softsat", "Indifferent", "Extremist"),
           Mode = fct_relevel(Mode, "Paper", "Web")) |> 
  group_by(Wave, Mode, Indicator) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Indicator, y = ProbOmega, fill = Indicator, color = Indicator)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge2()) +
  
  geom_text(
    data = n_labels,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5,
    size = 2.5,          # considerably smaller than 4.5
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Wave), cols = vars(LC, Mode), drop = TRUE) +
  
  force_panelsizes(
    rows = unit(rep(28, 3), "mm"),   # 3 Waves à 28 mm Höhe
    cols = unit(rep(30, 6), "mm")    # 6 LC/Mode-Kombis à 30 mm Breite
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values  = cbPalette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cbPalette) +
  
  labs(y = expression(paste("Estimated Endorsement Probability (", hat(omega)[~italic("m|k")], ")"))) +
  
  papaja::theme_apa() +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_legend(
      nrow      = 2,
      keywidth  = unit(0.35, "cm"),
      keyheight = unit(0.35, "cm")
    ),
    color = "none"      # merge fill & color -> only one legend
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(family = "sans", size = 9, color = "black"),
    strip.text.x       = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 2, b = 2, unit = "pt")),
    strip.text.y     = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", angle = -90),
    panel.spacing    = unit(0.3, "cm"),                  # enger als 0.8
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = 3),
    legend.position      = "bottom",
    #legend.justification = "left",
    legend.location      = "plot",
    legend.title         = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 8),       # runter von 12
    legend.box.background = element_rect(linetype = "solid", color = "lightgrey"),
    legend.box.margin    = margin(1, 1, 1, 1),
    legend.margin        = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "mm"),
    plot.margin          = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "mm")
  )

omegas_plot
```

```{r}
  c(PropPostProb   = "bold('A:')~'Based on'~hat(pi)[italic('c')]",

)

  ) +
    
facet_grid(
  . ~ ProbType,
  scales  = "fixed",

) +

  labs(y = "Proportion") +

  theme(

    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = 3),
    strip.text   = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0),  # Panel-Labels "A" / "B"
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold" ),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 11)
  )
```

# Multinoms SocDem

## Sample

```{r}

p_load("readxl")

mn_df <- 
  read_excel(paste0(userpath, "Sample_Summaries.xlsx"), 
     sheet = "MultinomSocDem") |> 
  select(Model:UUOR) |>
  mutate(Model = str_replace(Model, "_", "\n")) |> 
     #    Variable = str_replace(Variable, "_", "\n")) |>
    mutate(Model = fct_relevel(Model,
                               "Wave 1 Paper\n (N = 5,670)", 
                               "Wave 1 Web\n (N = 3,777)", 
                               "Wave 2 Paper\n (N = 5,105)",
                               "Wave 2 Web\n (N = 3,795)",
                               "Wave 3 Paper\n (N = 2,559)",
                               "Wave 3 Web\n (N = 5,568)")) |> 
   
  mutate(
    # clean NAs and infinite values
    across(c(`Est (log-Odds)`, LLLogit, UUlogit), 
           ~ if_else(is.infinite(.x), NA_real_, .x)),
    
    # significance is evaluated on the logit scale
    significant = case_when(
      LLLogit > 0 & UUlogit > 0 ~ "positive",
      LLLogit < 0 & UUlogit < 0 ~ "negative",
      TRUE                       ~ "insignificant"
    ),
    
    # flags marking estimates outside the plotting range
    clipped_high = is.na(`Est (log-Odds)`) | UUlogit > 2 | `Est (log-Odds)` > 2,
    clipped_low  = is.na(`Est (log-Odds)`) | LLLogit < -2 | `Est (log-Odds)` < -2,
    clipped      = clipped_high | clipped_low,
    
    # plotted values (clipped on both sides)
    Est_plot = pmin(pmax(`Est (log-Odds)`, -2), 2),
    LL_plot  = pmin(pmax(LLLogit, -2), 2),
    UU_plot  = pmin(pmax(UUlogit, -2), 2),
    
    # arrow start points (minimum shaft length of 0.3 units)
    arrow_start_high = pmin(LL_plot,  1.7),
    arrow_start_low  = pmax(UU_plot, -1.7)
  )
  
  
head(mn_df,9)
posn_d2 <- position_dodge(1)


#p_load(ggh4x)

multinom <- 
  mn_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x     = Est_plot,
             y     = as.factor(Variable),
             group = Model,
             color = significant)) +
  
  geom_point(data = ~filter(., !clipped),
             aes(x = Est_plot),
             size = 1,
             position = posn_d2) +
  geom_errorbarh(data = ~filter(., !clipped),
                 aes(xmin = LL_plot, xmax = UU_plot),
                 position = posn_d2) +
  geom_point(data = ~filter(., clipped_high & !clipped_low),
             aes(x = Est_plot),
             size = 1,
             position = posn_d2) +
  geom_segment(data = ~filter(., clipped_high & !clipped_low),
               aes(x = arrow_start_high, xend = 2,
                   y = as.factor(Variable), yend = as.factor(Variable)),
               arrow     = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
               linewidth = 0.6,
               position  = posn_d2,
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = ~filter(., clipped_low & !clipped_high),
             aes(x = Est_plot),
             size = 1,
             position = posn_d2) +
  geom_segment(data = ~filter(., clipped_low & !clipped_high),
               aes(x = arrow_start_low, xend = -2,
                   y = as.factor(Variable), yend = as.factor(Variable)),
               arrow     = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
               linewidth = 0.6,
               position  = posn_d2,
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("negative"      = "#1A85FF",
               "positive"      = "#D41159",
               "insignificant" = "#4D4E4E"),
    labels = c("negative"      = "Negative association (CI < 0)",
               "positive"      = "Positive association (CI > 0)",
               "insignificant" = "Non-significant (CI includes 0)"),
    name  = NULL,
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1, shape = 19))
  ) +
  
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2, 2), clip = "off") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-2, 2, by = 1)) +
  
  labs(x = "Log-Odds with 95%-CI", y = NULL) +
  
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Comparison),
             cols = vars(Model),
             drop = TRUE) +
  
  force_panelsizes(
    rows = unit(rep(40, 3), "mm"),   # jedes der 3 Row-Panels: 40 mm hoch
    cols = unit(rep(28, 6), "mm")    # jedes der 6 Col-Panels: 28 mm breit
  ) +
  
  papaja::theme_apa() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x    = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(t = 5)),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
    strip.text.x    = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(b = 3, t = 3)),
    strip.text.y    = element_text(size = 9, angle = -90, margin = margin(l = 2, r = 2)),
    axis.title.y    = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y   = element_line(color = "grey", linewidth = 0.1),
    legend.position      = "bottom",
    legend.margin        = margin(t = 8),
    legend.box.spacing   = unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.spacing        = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    panel.background     = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    strip.background     = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "mm")
  )

multinom

#        dpi    = 300, 
#        bg = "transparent")
```

## SensAn


```{r}

p_load("readxl")

mn_df_sensan <- 
  read_excel(paste0(userpath, "Sample_Summaries.xlsx"), 
     sheet = "MultinomSocDem_SA") |> 
  select(Model:UUOR) |>
  mutate(Model = str_replace(Model, "_", "\n")) |> 
     #    Variable = str_replace(Variable, "_", "\n")) |>
    mutate(Model = fct_relevel(Model,
                               "Paper\n (N = 10,556)", 
                               "Web\n (N = 6,467)")) |> 
   
  mutate(
    # clean NAs and infinite values
    across(c(`Est (log-Odds)`, LLLogit, UUlogit), 
           ~ if_else(is.infinite(.x), NA_real_, .x)),
    
    # significance is evaluated on the logit scale
    significant = case_when(
      LLLogit > 0 & UUlogit > 0 ~ "positive",
      LLLogit < 0 & UUlogit < 0 ~ "negative",
      TRUE                       ~ "insignificant"
    ),
    
    # flags marking estimates outside the plotting range
    clipped_high = is.na(`Est (log-Odds)`) | UUlogit > 2 | `Est (log-Odds)` > 2,
    clipped_low  = is.na(`Est (log-Odds)`) | LLLogit < -2 | `Est (log-Odds)` < -2,
    clipped      = clipped_high | clipped_low,
    
    # plotted values (clipped on both sides)
    Est_plot = pmin(pmax(`Est (log-Odds)`, -2), 2),
    LL_plot  = pmin(pmax(LLLogit, -2), 2),
    UU_plot  = pmin(pmax(UUlogit, -2), 2),
    
    # arrow start points (minimum shaft length of 0.3 units)
    arrow_start_high = pmin(LL_plot,  1.7),
    arrow_start_low  = pmax(UU_plot, -1.7)
  ) |> 
  
  mutate(
  Comparison = case_when(
    Comparison %in% c("Extremist* vs. Indifferent") ~ "Extremist*\n vs. Indifferent",
    Comparison %in% c("Extremist* vs. Softsat")     ~ "Extremist*\n vs Softsat",
    Comparison %in% "Indifferent vs. Softsat"       ~ "Indifferent\n vs. Softsat"
  ),
  # set the category order explicitly:
  Comparison = fct_relevel(Comparison,
    "Extremist*\n vs. Indifferent",
    "Extremist*\n vs Softsat",
    "Indifferent\n vs. Softsat"
  )
)
  



multinom_sensan <- 
  mn_df_sensan |> 
  ggplot(aes(x     = Est_plot,
             y     = as.factor(Variable),
             group = Model,
             color = significant)) +
  
  geom_point(data = ~filter(., !clipped),
             aes(x = Est_plot),
             size = 1,
             position = posn_d2) +
  geom_errorbarh(data = ~filter(., !clipped),
                 aes(xmin = LL_plot, xmax = UU_plot),
                 position = posn_d2) +
  geom_point(data = ~filter(., clipped_high & !clipped_low),
             aes(x = Est_plot),
             size = 1,
             position = posn_d2) +
  geom_segment(data = ~filter(., clipped_high & !clipped_low),
               aes(x = arrow_start_high, xend = 2,
                   y = as.factor(Variable), yend = as.factor(Variable)),
               arrow     = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
               linewidth = 0.6,
               position  = posn_d2,
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = ~filter(., clipped_low & !clipped_high),
             aes(x = Est_plot),
             size = 1,
             position = posn_d2) +
  geom_segment(data = ~filter(., clipped_low & !clipped_high),
               aes(x = arrow_start_low, xend = -2,
                   y = as.factor(Variable), yend = as.factor(Variable)),
               arrow     = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
               linewidth = 0.6,
               position  = posn_d2,
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("negative"      = "#1A85FF",
               "positive"      = "#D41159",
               "insignificant" = "#4D4E4E"),
    labels = c("negative"      = "Negative (CI < 0)",
               "positive"      = "Positive (CI > 0)",
               "insignificant" = "Non-significant (CI includes 0)"),
    name  = "Association",
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1, shape = 19),
                         title = "Association",
                         nrow = 1)
  ) +
  
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2, 2), clip = "off") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-2, 2, by = 1)) +
  
  labs(x = "Log-Odds with 95%-CI", y = NULL) +
  
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Comparison),
             cols = vars(Model),
             drop = TRUE) +
  
  force_panelsizes(
    rows = unit(rep(40, 3), "mm"),   # 3 Comparison-Rows à 40 mm
    cols = unit(rep(28, 3), "mm")    # ggf. Spaltenanzahl anpassen
  ) +
  
  papaja::theme_apa() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x    = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(t = 5)),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    strip.text.x    = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(b = 3, t = 3)),
    strip.text.y    = element_text(size = 9, angle = -90, margin = margin(l = 2, r = 2)),
    axis.title.y    = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y   = element_line(color = "grey", linewidth = 0.1),
    
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8,face = "bold"),
    legend.position      = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "left",    # <-- linksbündig
    legend.location      = "plot",    # <-- relativ zum gesamten Plot, nicht nur Panel
    legend.box.margin = margin(l = 5, unit = "mm"),
    legend.margin        = margin(t = 2, l = 5, unit = "mm"),
    legend.box.spacing   = unit(0, "pt"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "mm"),
    
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.spacing.x      = unit(0.7, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y      = unit(2, "lines"),
    panel.background     = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    strip.background     = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA)
  )

multinom_sensan
```
